qsq4gfxr.baseName: COSTWAY 6.5FT Artificial Pencil Christmas Tree with LED Lights-Green
qsq4gfxr.variantName: COSTWAY 6.5FT Artificial Pencil Christmas Tree with LED Lights-Green
qsq4gfxr.sourceDescription: With pre-installed warm white LED lights, this artificial, Christmas, pencil tree saves you the hassle of hanging lights on the tree and with the hinged designed branches, the tree is effortlessly built and ready to dress in no time! The slim Christmas pencil tree is perfect for small rooms or hallways. Do not hesitate to place an order! Romantic Lights: The Christmas pencil tree has warm white LED light spaced throughout, providing a bright glow that will spread throughout your room. High-Quality Leaves: With a mix of high-quality PVC and PE branches, the Christmas tree is realistic and durable. The mix of materials and leaf shapes helps to achieve a natural gradation in texture, appearance, and colour. Folding Mental Stand: The sturdy metal stand improves the overall stability of the tree. Even if you hang other decorations on it, it's stable enough to keep your Christmas tree standing up straight and prevent it from tipping over. The stand also folds up quickly and easily for storage. The stand also has protective pads on base to help protect flooring. Lush Branches: The Christmas pencil tree is designed to resemble a natural pine tree, and the thick, multi-leaf branches create a uniform, full tree which can be shaped to suit your style and ornaments. Widely Uesd: Suitable for indoor use, this Christmas tree will add a festive look this Christmas season. Whether you are building your own family scene or a commercial scene, this tree will attract attention. Personalise the tree with baubles and create a festive backdrop. Specifications Colour: Green Main material: PVC, iron Overall dimensions:67 cm x 195 cm Number of tips:708 Number of lights: 250 Net weight: 5 kg Box Qty:1(May vary by batch) Is Assembly Required: Yes Package includes: 1 × Pre-lit Christmas tree 1 × Stand 1 × Adapter Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

qa5wj1tg.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Half Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 120 cm
qa5wj1tg.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Half Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 120 cm
qa5wj1tg.sourceDescription: This artificial half Christmas tree forms the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations, creating a unique Christmas atmosphere! This beautiful Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance. The steel feet add to its stability. this artificial tree can be placed against the wall to save more space. The Christmas tree can also be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Featuring energy-efficient LED lights, it lights up beautifully and creates a cosy holiday atmosphere. What's more, decorated with the beautiful peak and balls, this Xmas tree will be eye-catching in your home. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Tree colour: Green Shiny rose gold, matt rose gold and glitter rose gold Material: PVC, steel, plastic Tree width: 68 cm Total height: 120 cm LED string light length: 15 m Voltage: DC 5 V Power: 5 W With 250 tips With 150 LEDs With USB connection Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball Maximum 110 kg per seat. Be aware of the risk of open fires and other sources of strong heat in the vicinity of the product. GPSR • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

hby4dkgh.baseName: Pegdev Red Rattan Style Christmas Tree Skirt Base Cover
hby4dkgh.variantName: Pegdev Red Rattan Style Christmas Tree Skirt Base Cover
hby4dkgh.sourceDescription: The Pegdev Red Rattan Style Christmas Tree Skirt creates a neat festive finish around the base of your tree. The red, woven rattan-effect design helps conceal the legs, trunk or stand and complements both traditional and contemporary Christmas decorations. Made from steel, the decorative cover is supplied in seven pieces that slot together for assembly. It folds flat for compact storage after Christmas, ready for reuse in future seasons. No specific safety warnings required when used as intended. Please use the product in accordance with its intended purpose. Pegdev Limited, Haywood Park Cotts (Main A513), Shugborough, Stafford, ST17 0XA.
